steps.body: Six triangles meeting at a single centre point make a hexagon — a shape with six straight sides.
steps.narration: Six triangles meeting at a single centre point make a hexagon — a shape with six straight sides.

widget.prompt: Sort each build: does it make a hexagon?

items.label: six triangles round a centre
items.feedback: Six triangles meeting at one point close into a six-sided hexagon.

items.label: two triangles on their long edges
items.feedback: Two triangles make a four-sided square, not a hexagon.

items.label: two squares side by side
items.feedback: Two squares make a four-sided rectangle.

items.label: six equal triangles in a ring
items.feedback: A closed ring of six triangles forms a hexagon.

widget.missFeedback: Ask how many sides the finished outline would have.
widget.successFeedback: Sorted — only a full ring of six triangles closes into a hexagon.

predict.prompt: Six triangles meet at one centre point. How many sides does the finished outline have?
predict.reveal: Each triangle contributes one outer edge, so the ring closes with six sides — eight triangles would close with eight. Counting three counts one triangle's own sides, not the ring's.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g1s make hexagon.
invariants: A shape's defining attributes must stay fixed while colour, size and orientation vary.
misconceptions: Treating colour, size or orientation as if it decided what a shape is.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same shape?

explanationVariants: Many pieces can compose at once.

widget.prompt: What new shape do two triangles make when joined?

options.label: A square
options.feedback: Correct — joining two triangles makes a square because their long edges match exactly.

options.label: A circle
options.feedback: Straight-sided pieces cannot join into a circle; every edge they contribute stays straight.

options.label: A cone
options.feedback: That is a solid, but joining flat pieces edge to edge keeps the result flat.

options.label: Nothing — shapes cannot be joined
options.feedback: Shapes combine readily; a new, larger shape is exactly what composing produces.

hotspots.label: 3 sides

hotspots.feedback: Straight-edged triangles always leave straight sides on the outside.
